label: pjm 63 offercurve
definition: (PROBE, not promoted) pjm 63 offercurve: pjm 61 consolidate energy-only config + a one-lever offer-curve reshape. CC_REGULAR econ_high 1.38->1.60 + peak 5.0->6.0 (steepen CC upper econ ramp + widen duct-firing scarcity band); CT_PEAKER committed 1.25->1.10 / econ_low 1.05->0.95 / econ_high 1.40->1.20 / peak 4.0->3.0 (lower the whole peaker curve). No reserve co-opt. RESULT: lifted the price-duration BODY ~+0.5 $/MWh avg/yr (2023 26.42->26.87, 2024 24.89->25.38, 2025 35.06->35.59 avg) but the TOP TAIL stayed flat/down (max 2023 56.50->56.46, 2024 58.66->57.57, 2025 76.97->76.83). Diagnostic: the CC duct-firing peak tranche rarely clears so widening it didn't lift the max; lowering CT_PEAKER capped the max (the CT peaker is the model's top-hour marginal/ceiling unit). Offer-curve tuning (CLAUDE.md #1 second step), nothing fitted to the residual (#11). Memory peak 11.8 GB.
